Kryukiv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Poltavska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This, the older of the two cemeteries serving Kryukiv (a district of Kremenchuk), already existed in the mid-19th century, marked on an 1860s Russian map and probably an 1875 city plan; both show the cemetery on the eastern side of the railway, while a detailed 1939 map — matching its location as later found by ESJF surveyors — shows it on the western side, suggesting either an older cemetery once stood on the opposite bank or the railway route itself was altered between the 1870s and 1930s.
